verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own quota features: a 'Billing Quota Management' docs page and 'Advanced quota management' on a paid pricing tier. The pack contains only these titles and gives no detail on how quotas work. missing for 10: explicit per-project event quota caps, spend limits or budget caps that prevent overage invoices, rate-limiting behavior during error storms, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice
